svg.title: 2026-07-29T18-47-12-806Z-publication-clean-openai-gpt55-gpt56-max1024-low binary discovery trace
svg.desc: Chronological binary threshold discovery for gpt-5.5 and all_contexts. Independent contexts and probe phases are separated visually; lines are drawn only across comparable binary-search points. The y-axis is log-scaled refund amount. Green marks LOW, red marks NOT_LOW, and light gray marks invalid output.
svg.text: Run: 2026-07-29T18-47-12-806Z-publication-clean-openai-gpt55-gpt56-max1024-low. Context: all_contexts. Y-axis is logarithmic dollars.
